source_refs.note: 1. Industrial Activities: a main subheading of 33.4 Water Pollution due to Human Activities, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 254-254.

blocks.text: Industrial activities are the major source of water pollution. Factories often discharge harmful chemicals, heavy metals, and toxic waste directly into rivers, lakes, and oceans. The common industries that release pollution, are oil refineries, chemical plants, automobile industry, fertilizers, tanneries, etc.
